title: Billboard Español TV Launches New Original Series Featuring Bad Bunny, Carín León, Gloria Estefan & More
summary: Fuse Media and Billboard’s free Spanish-language programming slate expands to Amazon Prime Video.
contentText:
From candid coffee dates to chart-history time machines, Billboard Español TV is bringing Latin music’s biggest stars along for the ride, Billboard announced Thursday (Oct. 8).

The Spanish-language FAST channel from Fuse Media and Billboard is expanding its original programming slate with multiple new series featuring Bad Bunny , Alejandro Sanz , Carín León , Gloria Estefan , Los Tigres del Norte , Carlos Vives , Myke Towers , Natti Natasha , Romeo Santos , Prince Royce and more.

The channel, which is available for free in the U.S., is also expanding its distribution with a debut on Amazon Prime Video . The platform joins HP TV Plus, LiveTVx, Orka TV, Plex and Fuse+.

“At Billboard Español , we strive to bring fans closer to the artists they admire by creating unique moments and having one-of-a-kind conversations ,” Billboard ‘s co-chief content officer Leila Cobo said in a statement. “With Billboard Español TV, those conversations are coming to the big screen at home, for free and in their language.” 

The new lineup includes Billboard En Conversación , Billboard Presenta , Saliendo Con , 24 Horas Con , Billboard Chart Historia and Billboard News Entrevista , offering artist conversations, performances, behind-the-scenes access and artist-led experiences. New episodes featuring Laura Pausini, Maluma and Tokischa are slated for November, alongside the FAST premiere of Cafecito Con , hosted by Billboard ‘s associate editor Jessica Roiz.

“We created Billboard Español TV around the idea that fans want more than just the music — they want access to the artists, their stories and the culture surrounding them,” added Marc Leonard, chief content officer of Fuse Media. “This new slate brings Billboard ’s access to FAST in a way that is distinctive, premium and highly relevant to Spanish-speaking audiences.” 

Billboard Español TV presents a daily lineup of Billboard exclusives from 7 to 9 p.m. ET/4 to 6 p.m. PT.
